# My Cleveland Clinic

> > Cleveland Clinic's internal portal for departments, institutes, patient support programs, medical education, and employee resources across Ohio's premier healthcare system.

This site serves as the organizational hub for Cleveland Clinic's clinical departments (Anesthesiology Institute, Dermatology & Plastic Surgery, Bariatric & Metabolic Institute), specialized programs (Body Donation, BioRepository), and support services for patients, employees, and medical education. It encompasses everything from donor stories and cancer patient support to conference services and research innovations.

## Key Topics

- Cleveland Clinic
- Anesthesiology Institute
- medical education
- body donation
- cancer patient support
- bariatric surgery
- critical care
- pain management
- cardiothoracic anesthesia
- conference services
- continuing education
- donor stories
- outcomes research
- BioRepository
- surgical innovation

## Clinical Departments & Institutes

- [Bariatric & Metabolic Institute: Treatments](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/bariatric/treatments): Surgical & nonsurgical weight loss options including gastric bypass
- [Anesthesia Department & Centers](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/anesthesiology/depts): Anesthesiology Institute departments: critical care, cardiothoracic, pain
- [About Dermatology & Plastic Surgery](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/dermatology-plastic-surgery/about): Dermatology & Plastic Surgery Institute offering reconstructive services

## Patient Support & Resources

- [Frequently Asked Questions: Get Answers Fast](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/help): FAQ covering doctors, testing, locations, billing, insurance & records
- [Cancer Patient Support & Comfort Services](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/cancer/patient-education/jade-comfort-cart): JADE Comfort Cart program providing items for hospitalized cancer patients
- [Ears To You](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/cancer/patient-education/ears-to-you): Ears To You nonprofit providing emotional support for cancer patients

## Medical Education & Research Programs

- [About the Body Donation Program](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/body-donation/about): Body Donation Program supporting medical research & anatomy education
- [Biospecimen Access Guidelines](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/biorepository/about/biospecimen-access-guidelines): BioRepository governance, sample request process & IRB review guidelines
- [Conference Services](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/education/conference-services): Education Institute conference & event services with pre/post management

## Research Innovations & Stories

- [Surgical Innovation In Colorectal Surgery](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/digestive/research-innovations/worlds-first-single-port-proctocolectomy): World's first single-port proctocolectomy minimally invasive milestone
- [Donor Stories: Daniel L. Few](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/body-donation/donor-stories/few): Tribute to whole-body donor Daniel L. Few's legacy in medical education
- [Donor Stories: Sally Wilson](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/body-donation/donor-stories/wilson): Sally Wilson's story of giving back through whole-body donation legacy

## Support Services & Giving

- [Give to Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/about/giving): Philanthropy programs including VeloSano cancer fundraising & donations
- [Occupational Health](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/about/for-employees/occupational-health): Employee health services, workplace safety & HR resources for caregivers

## Optional

- [Editorial Policy](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/about/website/editorial-policy): Content standards, person-centered language & editorial process guidelines
